verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Windows has a first-party Microsoft Store that developers can submit apps to (windows-docs-3) and prepare for distribution (windows-docs-5). That implies a built-in store users can install from. However, all of this is developer-facing documentation, and nothing describes the end-user install experience. Missing for 10: end-user docs on browsing and one-click installing from the Microsoft Store, evidence that popular desktop apps are available there, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install flow.
